notes.title: “Magical Girls” meets “Military” meets “Destruction”!
notes.content:
Dear Users,

Brought to you by anime, video game, and military-loving Japanese solo developer OHBADO, Magusphere - Magical Cannon Girls is a 7-year project that is set to be released on PC and consoles in 2022.

Destroy enemies and entire cities as a "Magical Girl" armed with a "Magical Cannon" is this magical third-person shooter!
Wishlist on Steam today!
